title: yencoding: YencMetadata and DecodedPart missing Clone, PartialEq, Eq derives
description:
Why this exists: yencoding/src/lib.rs defines YencMetadata and DecodedPart with only #[derive(Debug)] (plus conditional serde). Neither type derives Clone, PartialEq, or Eq.

What goes wrong: callers cannot clone a DecodedPart (e.g. to keep a copy after passing one to add_part), cannot compare two decoded results in tests without manually comparing fields, and cannot use these types in sets or as map values. The yencoding-multi assembler tests work around this by constructing DecodedPart values inline rather than cloning, which is more verbose. Tests in downstream crates cannot assert_eq! on DecodedPart without a manual field-by-field comparison. Deriving PartialEq and Eq is the standard approach for data types used in tests.

Fix: add #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)] to YencMetadata and DecodedPart (both already have all fields that support these derives).
